home.title: Leaves that prevent forest fires become income
home.intro: At Pa Ton Phueng Community Enterprise in Mae Pong, Doi Saket, fallen dipterocarp leaves are gathered out of the community forest and made into plates, which takes wildfire fuel away with them. The cloth is printed by hand with fresh leaves and flowers — no chemicals, and no two pieces alike.

product.title: Choose a product
product.body: A shawl, a handkerchief, a shirt, a leaf plate or a small gift.

pattern.title: Choose a pattern
pattern.body: Pick patterns from the community's library, layer them, move and turn them.

colors.title: Adjust the leaf colours
colors.body: Recolour the print with dyes the leaves themselves give — teak, marigold, oroxylum.
